[SWS_CM_00194] Cancel the method call
⌈
The destructor of the re-
turned ara::core::Future object shall be used by the caller to cancel the request
after issuing a method call. Deleting the returned ara::core::Future object shall
result in the abort of the method call and ensure that any related buffers are released
and no result is returned to the caller.
⌋
